common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium illustrated fruit emblem for a cute Japanese fantasy card game's rule thumbnail, not a UI mockup. The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES only: image 1 supplies warm cocoa outlines and cream/pink/sage colors; image 2 supplies softly hand-painted anime illustration finish. Create an entirely new single fruit illustration, not an edit of the references. Art direction: tasteful hand-painted gouache and delicate colored-pencil finish, warm cocoa-brown contour lines, carefully shaped large silhouette with lovely botanical details and soft natural volume, refined illustrated game-item quality, warm gentle lighting, restrained creamy highlights, no harsh gloss. Clearly legible at 64px. One single centered object filling 80-85% of a square canvas, fully contained with generous transparent margin, true transparent background. No background, no ground shadow, no text, no logo, no characters or faces, no frame, no white sticker border, no sparkles or extra objects. Avoid stock emoji, generic clipart, flat vector look, plastic 3D or photorealism.
